SOURCE: ChatGPT frame 'ChatGPT Image Aug 21, 2026, 05_07_55 PM (4) copy.png' (2172x724).

RETOUCHED before publishing — the generator mis-set three words that are legible at
render size. Fixes are moved pixels, not drawn type (scripts/retouch-collection-all-banner.py):
  blue serum   'ADVANCED REPAIR / SEPAIR SERUM'      -> 'ADVANCED REPAIR / SERUM'
  matrixyl jar 'FULL & FIRMING TREEAENT / FREATMENT' -> 'FULL & FIRMING'
The two pink labels were checked at 100% and were already correct.

Every quoted line on every label is now correct at 100% zoom:
  blue  — COPPER PEPTIDE / ADVANCED REPAIR / SERUM / PREMIUM FORMULA / 2% GHK-CU | 30ML
  pink  — PDRN SKIN REPAIR / DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT / PREMIUM FORMULA / 1% (10,000 PPM) PDRN | 30ML
  rose  — PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR / DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT / PREMIUM FORMULA / PDRN | COLLAGEN | COPPER PEPTIDE | 50ML
  white — MATRIXYL 3000 PRO COLLAGEN / FULL & FIRMING / PREMIUM FORMULA

SIZING: the collection-banner box is a FIXED pixel height (375/400/440) across a
full-bleed width, so its aspect ratio swings from ~1.0 on a phone to ~5.8 on a
2560 monitor. No single image survives that. The new template therefore sets
image_size 'auto' (original image ratio, no crop at any width) and supplies a
separate portrait mobile crop. Parallax is off: it scales the image to 130% and
only ever shows 77% of its height, which cut the bottle bases.

REVISED 2026-08-24 after review — the header must keep the theme's STANDARD height
(image_size sm, 375/400/440), the same as every other collection page; an earlier
pass used image_size "auto" to avoid cropping and made these two headers taller
than the rest of the site. A fixed-height box crops by definition, so the master is
widened to 3000px instead: at a fixed height object-fit cover scales purely by
height, and the surplus width becomes croppable margin that the template's
object-position aims at the extension rather than at the product.
